    Apply this tab's state to an in-memory EML object. Called from run_generation() alongside apply_permissions_to_eml(), after make_eml() and before write_eml(). Every piece here is optional, so each call is skipped if its corresponding state is empty/NA.

    apply_org_context_to_eml.Rd

    force = TRUE / NPS = TRUE on every call, matching apply_permissions_to_eml()

    • see that function's docstring in 07_permissions.R for the rationale.

    apply_org_context_to_eml(my_metadata, state)

    Arguments

    my_metadata

    the in-memory EML object (post make_eml(), pre write_eml())

    state

    the list returned by org_contextServer()'s $data reactive, evaluated (i.e. state <- org_context$data())

    Value

    the EML object with content units, producing units, project, and cross-reference links applied
